evidence.note: Early swing against player: Hall superplex deals 29 and leaves Hitman rattled (HP 97 vs 130) — real deficit / comeback window opens.
Curated menu offers distinct trade-off: Vertical suplex 74% 'TARGET GROGGY payoff' vs Collar-and-elbow 90%; novice picks collar and Hall answers with grapple counter (t16) — setup fails to pay off.

Climb → missile dropkick loop lands (19 dmg, Hall rattled) but the same climb/dropkick/collar/counter pattern repeats at t27–38 and t31–38; move_repetition_rate 0.3182 and turn_count 43 (gate fail) make the mid-match feel samey.
Comeback completes at nearly even HP (50–51) via Sharpshooter tap-out; modest climax but near_fall_count 0 — no near-fall beat before finish.
Groggy as modifier is clear: after get_up, log says 'Hitman rises — still groggy from the impact!' with state.groggy [true,false]; only Fight to your feet was legal (single_choice_turns=1).
Minor ambiguity: Shake the cobwebs and Desperation strike both use the same note 'clear the haze before they punish you' despite different risk.
Optimal groggy cash-in is not hidden — Vertical suplex is curated under Big swing with explicit 'TARGET GROGGY payoff' label (also t17/27/29/35/37).

Pin visible when legal: Cover — pinfall attempt (intent Finish, label pin) alongside Sharpshooter 85%; curation_pin_visible true. Submission % reads as apply-hold chance in the choice label, not a win meter.
Curiosity remains around unused groggy payoffs: menu again shows Vertical suplex 'TARGET GROGGY payoff' while collar_elbow → grapple_counter keeps burning windows.
Submission finish is a reason to return, but 43-turn drag, log_uniqueness_ratio 0.5, and zero near falls make a full rematch only a maybe.

stickiness.rematch_reason: Want to test whether cashing TARGET GROGGY vertical suplexes breaks the climb/missile/collar/counter slog; the Sharpshooter finish was satisfying but the mid-match loop was exhausting.
stickiness.next_experiment: Re-run seed 101 with methodical (or aggressive) policy that picks Vertical suplex on groggy turns 15/27/35 instead of collar_elbow, and try pin on the t42 failed-rise cover window.
